raw_segments.text: Suddenly, he remembered that the purse and the things he had taken out of the old woman's
box were still in his pockets.
He had not thought till then of taking them out and hiding them.
He had not even thought of them while he was examining his clothes.
Instantly, he rushed to take them out and fling them on the table.
When he had pulled out everything and turned the pocket inside out to be sure there was
nothing left, he carried the whole heap to the corner.
The paper had come off the bottom of the wall and hung there in tatters.
He began stuffing all the things into the hole under the paper.
Therein, all out of sight and the purse too, he thought gleefully,
getting up and gazing blankly at the hole which bulged out more than ever.
Suddenly, he shuddered all over with horror.
My God, he whispered in despair.
Is that the way to hide things?
